# University of Idaho Library - Digital Collections

> Digital Collections platform providing access to digitized materials and resources from the University of Idaho Library.

Objects.lib.uidaho.edu serves as the digital collections interface for the University of Idaho Library, enabling discovery and access to digitized historical materials, archives, and institutional resources. The platform supports metadata harvesting and integrated search functionality across collections.

## Key Topics

- Digital Collections
- University of Idaho Library
- Digital Collections Search
- Metadata Harvesting
- Error Handling
- Help Resources
- 404 Errors
